analyses.content: 录音明确提到包专门用来“carried coins”，这里的“carried”完美对应题目的“carry”，所以填入coins。
你可能会在拼写上少写“s”，请注意听录音里明显的复数尾音，而且整体语义是装硬币，复数形式才符合常理。
In the 14th and 15th centuries, bags were called purses, exclusively carried coins.
录音中的“symbol of status”直接对应题目中的“symbolize their”，锁定status。
你可能会被前面列举的“keys”或“precious metals”带跑，但它们分别是具体装的物品和制作材料，不是“象征（symbolize）”的内容。

From the 16th century onward, priests often wore the purses, a hook with chains to which small things could be attached, such as keys, knife cases, scissors, and sewing tools. Since purses were often crafted from precious metals, they were also considered as a symbol of status.
录音最后一句的“attached to the belt”与题目完美重合，直接填belt。
你可能会因为跟丢而在14世纪的段落里找答案（前面提过“attached to the strings”），但本题在16到17世纪的分类下，千万别填错信息段。
Bags and purses came in a variety of designs for a number of purposes, such as bags with clasps, leather pouches. These were all worn attached to the belt.
题目里的“under”在录音中被同义替换成了“underneath”，其后的skirt就是直接答案。
你可能会听到“clothing”就想填，但细听会发现包是藏在衣物更具体的位置“skirt”下面，要抓住具体方位词后的名词。
In the 17th and 18th century, women's clothing was so large that one or two bags or a pocket could easily be hidden underneath the skirt.
录音里的“connected with”替换了题目的“associated with”，紧随其后的marriage即为正解。
录音前半句说了“not only used as coin purse”，你可能会忽略整体语义立刻填入coin，面对这种“不仅...而且...”的句型一定要听完重点的后半部分。
Medieval purses were not only used as coin purse, they also were closely connected with marriage.
题干的“full of”对应录音里的“stuffed with”，其后紧跟着的核心名词spices就是答案。
你可能会被后面补充举例的“lavenders”（薰衣草）或“cotton”（棉花）干扰，但题目问的是大方向上装满了什么，spices才是直接的宾语。
In a time when personal hygiene was poor, sweet bags were stuffed with sweet-smelling spices to get rid of bad smelling.
录音原词重现了“package for”，且跟在它后面并位于“such as”之前的gifts完美契合空缺处。
题目已经给了money和perfume作为例子，如果你只盯着局部听，可能会把后续的例子当成总括词，忽略了“such as”前真正的核心主干gifts。
Purses were often used as decorative package for gifts such as money, perfume, or jewels.
录音毫不绕弯地读出了“plastic and zippers”，这种并列结构极好定位，直接抓取zippers即可。
你可能会在前面听到“industrial materials”就急着找词填入，但必须耐心等到具体材料（plastic）出现，才能顺藤摸瓜听准答案。
In this particular case, plastic and zippers were introduced to the bag.
题干的“age of”在录音中原词出现，紧随其后的feminism就是正解。
这个长难句中干扰信息多，你可能会中途抓瞎填入“shoulder bag”或“buckles”，要牢记题干锁定的是“age of”后面的词。
The end of the 1960s saw the shoulder bag return, and with it came lots of buckles, all of which indicated that women and their bags were ultimately fit and ready for the beginning age of feminism.
录音中的“sports bags... match athletic shoes”直接对应了题目“包用于体育（sports）以匹配鞋子”的逻辑。
你可能会只听局部而误填具体的品牌“Nike”，但题目需要的是表示包用途的宏观分类词，别被具体举例带偏了整体语义。
For instance, sports bags such as Nike bags, match athletic shoes were most popular at this time.
